   249→// startProgressDots prints dots to w every second until the returned stop function
   250→// is called. The stop function prints the given suffix and a newline.
   251→func startProgressDots(w io.Writer) func(suffix string) {
   252→	done := make(chan struct{})
   253→	stopped := make(chan struct{})
   254→	go func() {
   255→		defer close(stopped)
   256→		ticker := time.NewTicker(time.Second)
   257→		defer ticker.Stop()
   258→		for {
   259→			select {
   260→			case <-done:
   261→				return
   262→			case <-ticker.C:
   263→				fmt.Fprint(w, ".")
   264→			}
   265→		}
   266→	}()
   267→	return func(suffix string) {
   268→		close(done)
   269→		<-stopped // Wait for goroutine to finish before writing suffix

content.text:
Confirmed — all failures are pre-existing on main. My change is clean.

The change adds `--filter=blob:none` to the `git fetch` command in `fetchAndMergeSessionsCommon` (line 162 of `push_common.go`). This performs a partial fetch that downloads only commits and trees, skipping blob objects. The merge logic only needs the tree structure to combine entries — blobs referenced by the merged tree are either already local or will be fetched on demand if needed.
